summary: 19-year-old driver lost control above Barker Reservoir the day before Thanksgiving 2016; car rolled and slid backward into the reservoir; driver self-extricated before submersion and was treated for hypothermia; Nederland PD/Fire called mutual-aid dive teams (Boulder Emergency Dive Team, Longmont Dive Team) to recover the submerged vehicle
responding_agency: Nederland Police Department; Nederland Fire Protection District; Boulder Emergency Dive Team; Longmont Dive Team
notes: Incident date 2016-11-23 inferred from the story's "day before Thanksgiving" (Thanksgiving 2016 = Nov 24) plus story-id adjacency to the Nov-25 dog incident (story 3214, id 3048 — a different incident); parent-opened. Mined from the Mountain-Ear 2016-window angle, run 730 chunk B.
